messages:
pat: kicking off change window for text-gen-service — rolling v1.4-quant to 15% now. primary checks: p95, 5xx, and GPU mem saturation. deploy-bot: rollout started: text-gen-service -> v1.4-quant (15%). rollout id r-2026-03-23-11 :rocket:
nina: monitoring SLO dashboard (/dash/slo/text-gen-service). will alert if p95 > 140ms or 5xx > 0.4%. :eyes:
theo: FYI I changed the batching threshold in the canary config (lower max-batch-size to 8) to reduce latency for short prompts. noted in release notes.
telemetry-bot: perf-check: baseline diff scheduled (30s). collecting p50/p95/p99 and 5xx by region.
ops-bot: note: autoscaler observed slight pod churn in us-east-1 last 10m (no impact previously).
nina: canary p95 us-east-1 = 165ms (baseline 120ms) — crossing alerting threshold. :warning:
theo: seeing small rise in gpu memory spikes on canary pods in us-east-1; model kv cache size looks larger with quantized weights. linking logs: https://logs.internal/xyz789
pat: hold the ramp. do not move to 40%. acking alerts.
telemetry-bot: anomaly detected: 5xx rate in canary slice increased from 0.06% to 0.6% in last 15m. alert id slo-1122. paging eng-oncall in 3m unless acknowledged.
pat: acknowledged. we'll triage. nina — can you run the quick PromQL for 5xx by pod?
nina: ```query
sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="text-gen-service",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (pod)
```
nina: top contributor = text-gen-canary-7f6d (42 of 58 errors), latency traces show OOMKilled in sidecar preprocessor occasionally.
theo: sidecar preprocessor OOM? I increased LRU cache earlier; maybe combined with quantized model memory footprint pushed node memory. I'll patch the sidecar to lower cache to 128MB and restart canary pod.
theo: running:
```bash
kubectl set env deployment/text-gen-canary SIDE_CACHE_MB=128 -n prod
kubectl rollout restart deployment/text-gen-canary -n prod
```
ops-bot: rollout restart detected. pods recycling.
nina: after restart canary p95 down to 125ms, 5xx down to 0.09%. good recovery.
pat: proposal: keep canary at 15% for 45m with the adjusted sidecar cache. if stable, continue ramp to 50%. if regression reappears, pin to v1.4-legacy.
theo: also propose adding a pre-ramp memory check script to fail fast if node free memory < 1.5GB. creating INF-1024.
telemetry-bot: note: consider adding a short-lived cache-warm job to populate model KV caches before next ramp.
pat: agreed. nina annotate the release notes with the cause (sidecar LRU + quantized model memory), mitigation (lowered sidecar cache, restart), and next steps (pre-ramp mem check, warmup job). link: https://docs.internal/releases/text-gen/2026-03-23
ina: done. added notes and linked INF-1024 ticket.
deploy-bot: rollout update: text-gen-service -> v1.4-quant at 15% (stable after sidecar patch).
ops-bot: reminder: to pin use `deployctl pin --service text-gen-service --version v1.4-legacy --reason "canary OOM/5xx spike"` (executes immediate traffic shift).
pat: thanks all. keeping thread open for 45m. reconvene then to decide ramp vs. pin. :thumbsup:
